verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so open-protocol access and standards-based export are a fair axis, but the evidence pack never mentions IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access to mail held in Missive. It also never mentions an mbox/EML-style export. The only programmatic access documented is a proprietary REST API and an MCP server, which do not satisfy the open-protocols-and-standard-formats requirement, so the verdict is none.
